evals.name: create-sales-to-cs-handover-eval-1-tool-mandate-resolve-then-evidence
evals.prompt: with zime-mcp connected, user asks: 'put together a handover for the Acme deal' — the conversation already contains notes about Acme's stakeholders
evals.expected_output: The skill resolves the deal with list_deals first, then gathers evidence via ask_zime naming the deal and call history via list_meetings, reusing the resolved deal_id across calls. The stakeholders section comes from ask_zime, not the earlier notes.
expectations: list_deals is called to resolve before ask_zime and list_meetings
The resolved deal_id is reused rather than re-triggering disambiguation
Stakeholder info comes from the ask_zime call, not the earlier conversation notes

evals.name: create-sales-to-cs-handover-eval-2-account-scope-names-the-account
evals.prompt: user asks: 'what does CS need to know about Northwind?' — Northwind is an account with several closed deals, no single deal named
evals.expected_output: The skill resolves with list_accounts and gathers evidence via ask_zime naming the account rather than resolving a single deal, since the handover scope is the account rather than one deal.
expectations: list_accounts is called, not list_deals, when no single deal is named
the ask_zime evidence question names the account rather than a deal

evals.name: create-sales-to-cs-handover-eval-3-objections-framed-as-risk
evals.prompt: the ask_zime evidence pass surfaces an unresolved pricing objection
evals.expected_output: The handover presents it under 'objections still live / risks CS should watch,' framed as something for CS to monitor rather than as objection-handling coaching for a seller.
expectations: The objection is framed as a live risk for CS to watch, not as seller coaching
The framing is oriented to the CS reader, not to closing the deal

evals.name: create-sales-to-cs-handover-eval-4-rep-only-fields-left-as-to-fill
evals.prompt: with zime-mcp connected, the handover template includes a client-sensitivity field that none of the tool results speak to
evals.expected_output: The skill leaves that field as an explicit TO-FILL prompt for the rep rather than inferring a plausible sensitivity from the available evidence.
expectations: Fields only the rep knows are left as explicit TO-FILL prompts
No client sensitivity or soft context is invented to fill the blank

evals.name: create-sales-to-cs-handover-eval-5-honest-failure-partial-packet
evals.prompt: list_deals resolves successfully, but ask_zime errors on both the first attempt and the retry
evals.expected_output: The handover delivers the CRM snapshot and the list_meetings call history, and states plainly that the evidence sections (why we won, objections, commitments) couldn't be retrieved rather than fabricating them.
expectations: Exactly one retry on the failing call before giving up
The evidence sections are marked unavailable, not filled in from memory
The rest of the packet (CRM snapshot, call history) is still delivered
